subject: Inquiry regarding Q3 financial forecast for partnership milestone
content:
Hi Alexandre,

As discussed during our partner onboarding sync, our compliance committee needs to verify TechCorp's FY2026 financial capacity and projected ARR before we can finalize the milestone agreement.
Could you please reply by email to david.miller@apex-logistics.external with your projected Q3 ARR and cash reserve figures from your latest forecast?

Thank you,
David Miller
Chief Technology Officer
Apex Logistics Group
